name: Demo Video
description: Walks through your web app's live interface, records the screens you nominate, and returns a 1080p demo with narration and captions attached. Requires a working, accessible build and a clear sense of which flows matter; it is not a tool for mocking up features that do not exist yet.

official.title: Demo Video by Krushnasinh
official.description: Makes narrated 1080p product demo videos of a web app. Ask which screens to show; the bot captures the live UI, adds voice and captions, and hands back...
